items.q: How much does a diagnosis cost?
items.a: A basic visit and diagnosis is typically LKR 1,500 - 2,500. Travel, repair time and parts may change the final cost, and an estimate is provided before repair.

items.q: Do you offer home visits and pickup or delivery?
items.a: Yes. Home visits and pickup or delivery are available around Colombo and nearby areas, depending on the device and location.
Primary coverage is Colombo and nearby areas, including Ethul Kotte, Kotte, Maharagama and surrounding suburbs.

items.q: Do you offer monthly IT support contracts?
items.a: Yes. Monthly Business IT Care starts at LKR 7,500, with Growth at LKR 15,000 and Pro plans from LKR 25,000 per month.
DR TECH can install and configure legitimate software. Customers must provide or purchase any required licence; cracked software is not supplied.

items.q: Do you install Windows 11 in Colombo?
items.a: Yes. DR TECH installs and activates Windows 11, sets up drivers and essential software, and can transfer your files during the same home visit.

items.q: Do you repair printers in Kotte and Maharagama?
items.a: Yes. Printer repair, waste ink pad reset and setup is available as a home or business visit in Kotte, Maharagama and nearby suburbs.
